owner_source.verbatim: Implement a permanent capability-challenge rotation fix in `u-dont-existDOTcom/universal-dev-architecture`.

normalized_outcome: Mission Control's existing single-writer daemon durably creates and rotates one current capability challenge for each statically authorized supervisor/chat pair, publishes each fresh GitHub nonce only to the hard-locked capability issue before activation, and lets relays resolve the current challenge without private registry or deployment-variable rotation. Historical challenges remain immutable provenance, expired receipts stay invalid, fresh capability proof remains mandatory, and the existing ownership, fixed-control, global scheduling, pacing, ambiguity, and GitHub-writer gates remain intact.

required_outcomes.observable: Static policy contains stable authorized supervisor/chat and exact capability-bus authority only; challenge ID, independent nonces, issuance, expiry, and current selection are generated and stored durably by the single-writer daemon.

Concurrent, restart, renewal, publication-failure, stale-receipt, wrong-binding, and migration tests prove at most one current challenge per exact supervisor/chat and no implicit capability pass or provider send.

GitHub nonce publication uses a distinct least-privilege credential through server code hard-locked to the configured repository and exact capability issue, publishes only the public fixture fields, verifies the returned issue binding, and never exposes the credential, MC nonce, or private locator.

The relay resolves the latest current challenge for the exact registered supervisor/chat from Mission Control; bootstrapCapability.challengeId is optional and deprecated, and no operator edit is required when a challenge rotates.
Applicable Mission Control, relay, repository, security, build, source-archive, and independent-review gates pass for the exact candidate without changing Somatic state or merging.

Only the currently accepted PRIMARY hotfix runtime is installed and live-tested: an expired/missing challenge rotates once, its public fixture exists, the unchanged private chat registration sees it, fresh preflight and capability proof validate, the old receipt fails, and ownership plus shared scheduling/pacing remain intact; SECONDARY and separate production are not activated or promoted.

non_satisfying_proxies: a cron job or operator procedure that edits challenge IDs or nonces in deployment variables
green unit tests without proving the exact PRIMARY hotfix runtime rotates and consumes a challenge
publishing a nonce before activation without hard-locking and verifying the exact configured capability issue
activating a challenge after failed or ambiguously bound GitHub publication
rotating a challenge while treating it as capability PASS without a fresh receipt
letting an expired or wrong-supervisor receipt satisfy decision admission
using broad GitHub write authority or exposing a credential, MC nonce, or private conversation locator
sending a ChatGPT message merely to rotate durable challenge state
changing the single-writer, MC-only ownership, fixed-controls, global queue, pacing, ambiguity, or failover architecture
modifying the Somatic repository or experiment state
deploying to separate production, activating SECONDARY, or merging without explicit authority
production_boundary: Implementation, review, and exact PRIMARY hotfix-runtime installation only. Separate production deployment, SECONDARY activation/promotion, Somatic work, and merge are forbidden.
next_direct_evidence: Establish the exact stable policy and durable-state seams, implement focused challenge-manager and relay selection tests first, then prove the exact reviewed candidate in the accepted PRIMARY hotfix runtime without touching separate production or activating SECONDARY.
